content: Kuur Kǝ Nennan Mǝ Nen Jesu Mo nJerusalem
Pak gurum mo tong nJudiya mo jì nAntiyok, ɓǝ mo jì kám nenseet nɗang Jesu nǝ mo nǝnee, <<Katɗang baa mo can wun, kaaɗe Wàar mǝ Mosis sat sǝ kas, ɓǝ baa wun mbǝ mak kat ɓam kas.>>

Pool kǝ Barnabas mo cìn ɓeetshik ɗes kǝ mo, nkaa kám mǝnǝ. Aasǝ ɓǝ, mo bǝlǝp Pool kǝ Barnabas kǝ pak gurum mo nɗǝǝn nen shinzeen nǝ mo, kǝ mmo dǝm nJerusalem pǝ jeplep mo ɗi, kǝ nennan mǝ Eklesiya mo, mbǝkǝ mmo dǝm ɓeetpwoo ɗesǝ nǝ ɗi.

Eklesiya mo ɓwet mo, ɓǝ mo taa mer nyil mFonisha kǝ Samariya. Mo satpwoo tuwap mǝ nen ɗe baa mo a nnen Yahudi mo kas, kǝzak kaaɗe mo le pǝtuup mo mo pǝ Naan ɗi. Pwoo ɗesǝ nǝ jì kǝ retnyit nnenseet nɗang Jesu nǝ mo hakyeng.
Kaaɗe mo wul nJerusalem, ɓǝ nenseet nɗang Jesu mo kǝ jeplep mo, kǝ nen ɗenan-nan mo, mo kaat mo. Yaksǝ mo yakshii mǝ mbii ɗe Naan wur cìn ashak kǝ mo jir.
Yaksǝ pak nen shinzeen ɗe mo a mǝ ar mǝ nen Farisi mo, mo yool kǝ pwoo nǝnee, <<Nǝ ret kǝ tǝng mo can nen ɗe baa mo a nnen Yahudi mo kas, kǝzak nǝ a tǝng mo tap Wàar mǝ Mosis rǝrret zak.>>
Jeplep mo, kǝ nen ɗenan-nan mǝ Eklesiya nǝ, mo kuur ashak, mbǝkǝ mmo naashii mǝ pwoo ɗesǝ nǝ ɗi.

Aɓwoon ɗe mo kǝ ɓeetpwoo nǝ ɗes ndǝr-ndǝr hakyeng, ɓǝ Pita yool ɗar atǝng, ɓǝ wur sat mmo nǝnee, <<Ɗyemnaa mo! Wu man nǝ, Naan shee bǝlǝp an mɓut nwun, mbǝkǝ nghan sat pwoo ɗeret nǝ ɗi nnen ɗe baa mo a nen Yahudi mo kas, kǝ mmo shinzeen ɗi.
Naan ɗewur man pǝtuup mǝ gurum mo jir, wur kám agaak nǝ, ɗyin ɗi lap mo, kaaɗe wur shin Riin Ɗeɓang mmo, nciit kǝ ɗe dǝ wur kǝ shin mmun sǝ zak.
Baa Naan ɓàkyit mmun kǝ mo kas. Wur vwang shikbish ɗe nɗǝǝn pǝtuup mo mo, a mbǝɗe mo shinzeen.
Mbǝ mǝnǝ yaksǝ, ɓǝ a mii le ɗang wun pǝ kam Naan ii? Wun nkaa le lée ɗe toon nkaa took mǝ nenseet nɗang Jesu mo, ɗe koo a puun fun mo, kǝ mun, ɓǝ baa mu mak mang lée nǝ mo kas.
Hai! Mu shinzeen nǝ, a mbǝ ɗeret mǝ Daa fun Jesu, ɗang mu kat ɓam, kaaɗe mo kat ɓam nǝ sǝ zak.>>

Kuur mǝ gurum nǝ mo ɗok tǝtǝk, kǝ mmo lekom mbǝ kǝlǝng pwoo mǝ Barnabas, kǝ Pool, kaaɗe mo nkaa leshap mmo nkaa mbii lukshik mo, kǝ mbii aapwoo mo, ɗe Naan le kǝ mPool kǝ Barnabas mo cìn, nɗǝǝn nen ɗe baa mo a nnen Yahudi mo kas.
Aɓwoon ɗe mo kyes leshap nǝ, ɓǝ Jemis sat nǝnee, <<Ɗyemnaa mo, wu lekom kǝ nwun kǝlǝng an ɗi.
Pita kǝ leshap nwun nkaa wal ɗe Naan shee kám nǝ nnen ɗe baa mo a nnen Yahudi mo kas. Wur shwat pak mo nɗǝǝn mo, mbǝkǝ mmo ɗee ɗi a nen fin mo.
Ɗesǝ nǝ a nciit kǝ pwoo mǝ nensatpwoo mǝ Naan mo, ɗe mo kǝ ten ran nɗǝǝn ɓǝǝt-haal mǝ Naan nǝnee,
<Aɓwoon ɗesǝ ɓǝ an mbǝ baajì. Mbǝkǝ nghan mbaa ɗi kǝ lu mǝ Devit ɗe nǝ shirip sǝ ɗi. An mbǝ baa ɗiyeep kǝrem lu ɗe mo kǝ shirip nǝ zak.
Mbǝkǝ nkoor gurum mo jir, ɓǝ mo jì tang Daa ɗi, kǝ jir nen ɗe baa mo a nnen Yahudi mo kas, ɗe an kǝn pǝrep mo, mbǝkǝ mo ɗee ɗi a nen fen mo.
A Daa kǝ sat a kǝsǝ! Wur kǝ ten le kǝ mbii ɗesǝ mo ɗee a ɗemǝman pegyet ɗi yam-yam.>
<<Mbǝ mǝnǝ, nnaa mǝnǝ, ɓǝ taji wu le nǝ luk nen ɗe baa mo a nnen Yahudi mo kas, ɗe mo ciir kǝ pǝtuup fur mo pǝ Naan ɗi.

Ɗangɓe mu ran lep a rǝran mmo, mbǝkǝ mmun sat ɗi mmo nǝnee. Taji mo se mee mbiise ɗe mo kǝ ten shin nkùm kas. Kǝzak taji mo cìn ngaa kas. Taji mo se luwaa mǝ long ɗe mo miyoor took nǝ kas. Kǝzak taji mo se toom kas zak.
Mbǝɗǝ mo kǝ tang Wàar mǝ Mosis nǝ peedǝ ɗi yam-yam, koo a parpuus Nookɗi ɗeɗangyii nɗǝǝn lu mǝ Naan nǝ mo jir, kǝ nɗǝǝn pee nkaam nǝ mo jir zak.>>
Mo Ran Lep nNen Ɗe Mo Shinzeen Ɗe Baa Mon A Nen Yahudi

Jeplep nǝ mo, kǝ nen ɗenan-nan mo, kǝ nen shinzeen nǝ mo jir, mo naa nǝ, nǝ ret kǝ mmo bǝlǝp pak gurum mo nnaar fur, mbǝkǝ mmo lep mo shindǝm Antiyok ashak kǝ Pool kǝ Barnabas. Ɓǝ mo bǝlǝp Judas ɗe moo pet wur a Barsabas, kǝ Silas zak, ɗe mo a ɗǝnan-nan mɓut nnen shinzeen nǝ mo.

Yaksǝ mo lep mo shindǝm ashak kǝ lep a rǝran ɗe nǝ sat nǝnee, <<Jeplep mo, kǝ nen ɗenan-nan mǝ Eklesiya mo, mun ɗyemnǝǝn fuu mo, muu lep tokshik fun ɗeɗes dǝm pǝ wun ɗyemnǝǝn fun, nenseet nɗang Jesu mo, ɗe baa wun a nnen Yahudi mo kas. Ɗe wuu tong nɗǝǝn yil Antiyok, kǝ Siriya, kǝ Silisiya.
Mu kǝlǝng nǝ, pak gurum mo nɗǝǝn nen ɗe mo pwat pǝ mun ɗi, mo kǝ dǝm daampee nwun shi pwoo mo, kǝ mmo ringshii nwun. Ɓǝ baa a mun mu lep mo kas.
Kaaɗe mu kuur ashak, ɓǝ pwoo fun mo seet ndangshak, ɓǝ mu naa nǝ, nǝ ret kǝ mmun bǝlǝp pak gurum mo, mbǝkǝ mmun lep mo dǝm pǝ wun ɗi. Mo dǝm ashak kǝ shaar fun mo Barnabas kǝ Pool.
Mo kǝ shin seen fur mo mbǝ cìn ɗak mǝ Daa fun Jesu Kristi.
Mbǝ mǝnǝ, mu lep Judas kǝ Silas dǝm pǝ wun ɗi. Mo shikáa fur, mon nyakshii mǝ mbii ɗe mǝ nran nɗǝǝn lep a rǝran nǝ nwun shi pwoo.
Mbǝɗǝ Riin Ɗeɓang kǝ naa nǝ ret, ɗang mmun mu naa nǝ ret a kǝsǝ zak, mbǝkǝ taji mo le mee lée toon nkaa wun, waa met mbii ɗesǝ mo kas.

Taji wu se mbiise ɗe mo kǝ ten shin nkùm kas, kǝzak taji wu se luwaa ashak kǝ toom kas. Taji wu se luwaa mǝ long ɗe mo miyoor took nǝ kas, ɗang taji wu cìn ngaa kas. Katɗang baa wuu cìn mbii ɗesǝ mo kas, ɓǝ nǝ ret zam. Ɗang mukaat. Wu tongriyang.>>
Mo lep nenlep nǝ mo shinseet, ɓǝ mo dǝm Antiyok, a mpee ɗe kuur mǝ nenseet nɗang Jesu mo ɗi ashak, ɓǝ mo shin lep ɗe a rǝran nǝ mmo.
Kaaɗe mo tang lep a rǝran nǝ ngurum nǝ mo, ɓǝ mo kǝlǝng retnyit zam, mbǝɗe pwoo nǝ fes gangkwak mmo zam.
Mbǝɗǝ Judas kǝ Silas, mo a nensatpwoo mǝ Naan mo zak, ɓǝ mo shínɓal ngurum nǝ mo mputuup zak.
Aɓwoon ɗe mo cìn rep teer mo nɗǝǝn Antiyok ɓǝ nenseet nɗang Jesu nǝ mo ɓwet mo ryang, mbǝkǝ mmo baa ɗi pǝ nen ɗe dǝ mo lep mo.
Ɗangɓǝ Silas naa nǝ nǝ ret kǝ nɗyin ɗi tong ɗi mpee mǝnǝ.
Ɓǝ Pool kǝ Barnabas mo tong nɗǝǝn Antiyok mbǝ rep teer mo. Mo nkaa kám, kǝzak mo nkaa satpwoo mǝ Daa, ashak kǝ pak gurum mo ɗes.
Pool Mo Ɓakshak Kǝ Barnabas
Aɓwoon meeteer mo ruk, ɓǝ Pool sat mBarnabas nǝnee, <<Nǝ ret kǝ mmun cin mu dǝm, mbǝkǝ mmun tok kǝ nenseet nɗang Jesu mo nɗǝǝn koo a pee nkaam ɗeɗangyii ɓe kǝ mun nakoom mu ɗi.>>
Barnabas reɓet kǝ mmo seet ashak kǝ Joon ɗe moo pet wur a Maak.
Ɗangɓǝ Pool naa baa nǝ ret kǝ nwur seet ashak kǝ mo a peeɗak nǝ kas. Mbǝɗǝ dǝ wur kǝ su yit mo ɗe nyil mPamfiliya kǝzak baa wur sekyeen ashak kǝ mo nɗǝǝn ɗak nǝ kas.
Ɓǝ ɓeetshik yool mmo nnaar, ɗe nǝ le mmo ɓàkshak. Barnabas mang Maak ashak kǝ wur, ɓǝ mo ɗel nɗǝǝn tii kǝ mmo dǝm ɗi nSaiprus.
Ɗangɓǝ Pool bǝlǝp Silas. Ɓǝ aɓwoon ɗe nenseet nɗang Jesu mo ɗangnaan (leshap kǝ Naan), ɓǝ mo le mo nsar ɗeret mǝ Daa Naan, ɓǝ mo pwat seet.
Pool ɗel dǝm nɗǝǝn yil nSiriya kǝ Silisiya, wur nkaa gangkwak nnenseet nɗang Jesu ɗe mo mpeemǝnǝ jir.
